# Integration commands / 集成与调试命令

<!-- Generated by go generate ./packages/clihelp; edit the Go catalog. -->

These commands are used by integrations and isolated development workflows. Normal collaboration uses `connect` and the managed Runtime.

这些入口用于集成和隔离调试，日常协作无需手动调用。以下预算与模型参数仅适用于显式调试命令，不是普通用户配置项。

[User commands](cli.md).

## coconet

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [local-dag](#coconet-local-dag) | Low-level worker inspection and isolated development |
| [mcp](#coconet-mcp) | Run the stdio MCP server for an Agent integration |
| [hook](#coconet-hook) | Capture an Agent hook event from stdin |

### `coconet local-dag`

Low-level worker inspection and isolated development

```sh
coconet local-dag <command> --root DIR [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--root DIR` | — | Required: absolute private store directory |
| `--project ID` | — | Required except for serve/status/stop/inbox/retry-inbox |
| `--actor ID` | — | Required for capture/process/serve: origin device identity |
| `--input FILE` | — | Required for capture/observe: fixed JSON input, read-only |
| `--provider codex\|claude` | — | Required for process/serve: inference provider |
| `--command CMD` | — | Required for process/serve: provider executable |
| `--profile DIR` | — | Required for process/serve: absolute isolated Agent configuration directory |
| `--model MODEL` | — | Required for process/serve: explicit inference model |
| `--max-calls N` | 0 | Required for process/serve, 1-100; per process call or rolling 24 hours for serve |
| `--timeout DURATION` | 2m0s | Per-provider-call deadline; Go duration such as 120s or 5m |
| `--task ID` | — | retry/retry-inbox: exact task or event ID |
| `--node ID` | — | Required for pull: current DAG node |
| `--native` | false | pull: also materialize the original artifact |
| `--relay-config FILE` | — | Private Relay configuration; defaults to ROOT/relay.json |

Prefer normal managed commands (inference, projection, history, storage). These explicit provider/model/budget options are for development and do not change automatic source-Agent configuration.

When an existing daemon handles a request, it uses its own configuration. Use a separate store and Agent profile for isolated experiments.

### `coconet mcp`

Run the stdio MCP server for an Agent integration

```sh
coconet mcp [--agent codex|claude]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent codex\|claude` | — | Target Agent for native continuation tools; optional |

### `coconet hook`

Capture an Agent hook event from stdin

```sh
coconet hook --agent codex|claude [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent codex\|claude` | — | Source Agent type |
| `--skill-path FILE` | — | Installed Codex team-context Skill path; integration-managed |

Called automatically by the plugin. Ordinary hook execution is silent and fail-open.
